# Standard verbs

A noun that declares props and a store is a thing noun: it gets the standard verbs with no handler of its own. Every thing noun has each core verb; where the row's kind does not fit the store, or the store lacks what the row needs, the verb is listed but unavailable, with the reason. A verb that is not core exists on a noun only where the store has what it needs. A verb the noun declares by hand under a standard name replaces the generated one. A host mounting a tool's catalog gets the same verbs, forwarded.

| Verb | Core | Kinds | Needs | Subject | Many | Repeat | History | Undo | Confirm | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get` | yes | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get | yes |  |  | fetch |  |  | Read a thing's props: every prop as an object, one prop's value (prop), or some props (props) |
| `list` | yes | collection, instances | Store.List |  |  |  | fetch |  |  | List the things, each its props with id and label, as a page {items, page, per_page, total}; filter and where keep the things that meet conditions, sort orders them, group-by gathers them into groups, per-page and page cut the result into pages (rows, never groups) |
| `create` | yes | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Create, a prop create writes |  |  |  | change | delete |  | Create a thing from the props given (each omitted one its default); answers the new thing |
| `set` (`patch`) | yes | collection, singleton, instances | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Patch, a writable prop | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Write a thing's props: one prop (prop and value, or toggle on a boolean), or several (changes, or prop=value words); answers the thing after the write |
| `delete` | yes | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Delete | yes | yes |  | change | recreate | `Delete {{noun}} {{label}}?` | Delete a thing (asks first) |
| `archive` | yes | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Patch, a writable archive prop (role archive) | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Archive a thing: set its archive prop |
| `edit` | yes | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, Store.Patch, a writable prop, forms.edit | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Edit a thing's writable props in a form; supplied props write directly without opening a form |
| `watch` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Watch, else Store.List (a singleton: Store.Get) | yes |  |  | fetch |  |  | Stream what happens to the things (one, or those where matches): a JSON line per thing added, modified or deleted, from since when given; the CLI streams until interrupted |
| `rename` |  | collection, singleton | Store.Patch, a writable label prop (role label) | yes |  | yes | change | restore |  | Rename a thing: write its label prop (name; to when the key prop is named name); the form opens on the old name |
| `move` |  | collection | Store.Patch, a writable owner prop (role owner) | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Move a thing to another owner: write its owner reference (to) |
| `duplicate` |  | collection | Store.Get, Store.Create, a prop create writes | yes | yes |  | change | delete |  | Create a copy of a thing: every prop create writes, from the thing, with prop=value overrides (pairs or changes); answers the new thing |
| `restore` |  | collection | Store.Patch, a writable archive prop (role archive) | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Restore an archived thing: clear its archive prop |

The subject is the parameter named after the noun's key prop: given, it names the thing; left out, it is the thing the request acts for (the focus). Many runs once over a visual selection, as one undo step; a verb without both a subject and many is never run over a selection. Undo says how history.undo reverts the change: delete the thing made, restore the props written, or recreate the thing removed. Repeat: `.` repeats the write when it writes only simple values (enum, boolean, number, duration).
